mechanism.owner_quote: An asynchronous request-reply interface accepts a request, returns a durable handle and later exposes the terminal result through polling or a callback.
mechanism.reason: Defines a durable handle and later polling or callback result.

invariant.owner_quote: The handle must identify one recorded operation whose outcome is durable, so a lost reply cannot turn an accepted request into an unknown effect.
invariant.reason: Source binds duplicate-key idempotency, not the durable handle invariant; no exact handle-durability rule found.

failure_recovery.owner_quote: A lost or expired reply leaves the caller unable to decide the outcome; keep the operation record queryable and reconcile before retrying the original request.
failure_recovery.reason: Requires a queryable operation record and reconciliation before retry.

alternative.owner_quote: A synchronous call with a bounded deadline is simpler when the work reliably finishes inside the request budget; split the interaction only when waiting would exceed it.
alternative.reason: Names a synchronous bounded-deadline call when the work fits the request budget.

mechanism.owner_quote: A gatekeeper is a dedicated request-validation boundary that authenticates the caller and evaluates coarse authorization before forwarding a request to the protected service.
mechanism.reason: Defines a validation boundary before forwarding to the protected service.

invariant.owner_quote: The protected service must reject calls that bypass the gatekeeper, or repeat the security-relevant checks, so the boundary cannot be sidestepped by an alternate route.
invariant.reason: Requires the protected service to reject bypasses or repeat security checks.

failure_recovery.owner_quote: A stale policy or an undeclared direct path defeats the check while dashboards remain green; combine network policy, denial logs and a bypass test in the acceptance evidence.
failure_recovery.reason: Source names SPoF and redundancy, not stale-policy or bypass-detection recovery.

alternative.owner_quote: Enforce authorization inside the service at each effect boundary; use a gatekeeper when it centralizes a policy that every route must apply and the bypass surface is closed.
alternative.reason: Names in-service authorization at each effect boundary.
